name: GC–MS (Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry)
sample_types: essential oils, headspace (HS-SPME), distillates, residues, tinctures
output: identification + relative abundance (peak area); library match; targeted quant with standards
strengths: gold standard for terpenes/volatiles; rich libraries; supports fingerprinting
limitations: needs derivatization for some polar compounds; matrix effects; quant needs standards
sop_outline: sample prep → injection/HS-SPME → GC separation → MS scan/SIM → library match → QC blanks/standards

name: LC–HRMS (Liquid Chromatography–High Resolution MS)
sample_types: leaf extracts, herbarium extracts, resins, alkaloids, cannabinoids (acids)
output: feature table (m/z, RT) + MS/MS; untargeted metabolomics; targeted quant with standards
strengths: detects polar/non-volatile; excellent for untargeted historical samples
limitations: annotation bottleneck; ion suppression; requires careful QC & blanks
sop_outline: extraction → LC gradient → HRMS full scan + MS/MS → feature extraction → annotation/QC

name: GC×GC–TOFMS (Comprehensive 2D GC)
modality: 2D separation + TOFMS for complex volatile mixtures
sample_types: cannabis chemotypes, resins, complex headspace, aged tobacco/cigar volatiles
output: high-dimensional fingerprint; enhanced minor compound resolution
strengths: finds minor/trace compounds; excellent for 'ghost molecules' discovery
limitations: expensive; complex data processing; requires expertise
typical_markers: trace terpenoids; minor aromatic heterocycles; oxidation products
sop_outline: sample → GC×GC modulation → TOFMS acquisition → deconvolution → alignment → QC

name: HS-SPME (Headspace Solid-Phase Microextraction)
sample_types: flowers, cured leaves, resins, aging samples, space-emission sampling
strengths: very sensitive for headspace; minimal prep; good for time-series
limitations: fiber bias; semi-quantitative unless calibrated; temperature-sensitive
sop_outline: equilibrate sample → expose fiber → desorb in GC inlet → run GC–MS

name: Herbarium aDNA + Target Enrichment / Shotgun
modality: ancient/fragmented DNA sequencing from historical specimens
sample_types: herbarium leaves, pressed flowers, seeds, archived tissues
output: SNPs, haplotypes, gene presence/absence; links genotype ↔ metabolite potential
strengths: enables reconstruction of historical cultivars/landraces; track introgression
limitations: DNA damage; contamination; requires clean lab + bioinformatics
typical_markers: TPS gene alleles; cannabinoid synthase loci; nicotine pathway genes
sop_outline: clean extraction → library prep → enrichment/shotgun → sequencing → damage-aware mapping → variant calling
